name: modal
description: Experimental: manage Modal (modal.com) serverless compute resources — Secrets, Volumes, and Queues — as infrastructure with Pulumi.

nodejs.packageDescription: Experimental: manage Modal (modal.com) serverless compute resources — Secrets, Volumes, and Queues — as infrastructure with Pulumi.

environment.description: Default Modal environment (workspace namespace) for resources that don't set their own. Falls back to MODAL_ENVIRONMENT, then the account's default environment.

serverAddr.description: Override for Modal's gRPC control-plane endpoint. Only used for testing.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Falls back to the MODAL_TOKEN_ID environment variable.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Falls back to the MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET environment variable.

modal:index:Queue.description: A Modal Queue — a distributed FIFO/LIFO queue for passing data between Modal Functions, Sandboxes, and external callers. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/queues.

environment.description: The Modal environment the queue lives in. Changing this forces a new resource.

name.description: The queue's unique name. Changing this forces a new resource.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

environment.description: The Modal environment the queue lives in. Changing this forces a new resource.

name.description: The queue's unique name. Changing this forces a new resource.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

modal:index:Secret.description: A durable, named Modal Secret — a collection of key/value pairs Modal Functions mount as environment variables. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/secrets.

environment.description: The Modal environment the Secret lives in. Changing this forces a new resource.

name.description: The unique Secret name. Changing this forces a new resource.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

values.description: Key/value pairs exposed as environment variables to Functions that mount this Secret.

modal:index:Volume.description: A Modal Volume — a persistent, distributed filesystem mountable into Modal Functions and Sandboxes for caching model weights, datasets, or other large files across runs. See https://modal.com/docs/guide/volumes.

environment.description: The Modal environment the volume lives in. Changing this forces a new resource.

name.description: The volume's unique name. Changing this forces a new resource.

tokenId.description: Modal API token ID. Overrides the provider-level tokenId.

tokenSecret.description: Modal API token secret. Overrides the provider-level tokenSecret.

version.description: Volume filesystem version: "v1" or "v2" (default). Changing this forces a new resource.
